title: E-SPN-0100: the lowest fracton rung was the frozen key's: on a full-period key a lone vibe is already a lineon, fail...
purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0100 in the spin arena: the lowest fracton rung was the frozen key's: on a full-period key a lone vibe is already a lineon, fail on F1 and F5: with no mixer on two full-key paths (side 16) a lone love stays on its one mesh line but runs 8 dock steps, half the box (on the registered key it stays within 2, wake at most 3); two meeting loves stay on their two lines and run 8 steps, 'pass' and 'bounce' agreeing beat for beat; 434 and 436 of 528 two-vibe seeds reach lines off their own on side 8, quiet (largest wake 62 and 61; old key 442 and 59); the 6+8 and 14+18 clusters stay bounded for 128 beats (wake at most 105) on exactly 10 lines off their own, but reach them over about 48 beats, not by beat 16 (old key: 5 of 10 by beat 16, so 'by beat 7' was never the record); on 'bounce' no line is reached.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
